Peach Veil.notes: Use a thin targeted layer before skin-tone concealer.

Apricot Mist.notes: Designed as the deeper-skin companion to Peach Veil.

Butter Light.notes: Use sparingly to avoid visible yellow cast.

Sage Calm.notes: Deeper skin requires very sheer application until the final pigment strength is validated.

Lilac Air.notes: Use locally rather than as a full-face opaque layer.

Clear Air.note: Final no-flashback performance requires formula/photography validation.

delta_e00_thresholds.description: Do not present as a confident direct match.

legacy_user_curve_reference.reason_inactive: Its numeric output conflicts with the requested 85/65 confidence bands at the supplied delta-E boundaries.

seasonal_rules.summer_tanned: prefer +1 depth on same undertone axis; if unavailable rank target depth by delta_e00
seasonal_rules.winter_lighter: prefer -1 depth on same undertone axis; if unavailable rank target depth by delta_e00

dimension_rules.bronzer: choose depth-appropriate warmer shade; warmth is the goal, not shadow simulation
dimension_rules.contour: start around +2 depth tiers, clamp to available catalogue, prefer neutral/muted or depth-appropriate warm shadow
dimension_rules.highlighter: match by depth + undertone + desired intensity, not by foundation delta-E

user_instructions: No foundation, concealer, tinted moisturizer, or beauty filter.
Face a window or soft neutral light; avoid direct sunlight and coloured lighting.
Keep the whole face clearly visible.
